name: chao-garden
description: A chao garden above the typing box in the Claude desktop app. Chao hatch, grow and evolve from the work Claude does, find classes, and fight corrupted omochao. /chao to see them.

name.title: Your name
name.description: What your chao call you when they are happy ("I love you, <name>!"). Leave it empty and they just say "I love you!".
